name: ConvertLabs
description: All-in-one booking + marketing SaaS for home-service businesses (cleaning, lawn care, carpet cleaning, etc.) — bookings, payments, websites, and teams on one screen. Plans ~$67 / $197 / $397 per month. Founded Apr 2018, US. ~1,000 estimated users; 474 active subs.

mentions.evidence: ~$27,861 MRR, 474 active subscriptions, ~$30,539 L30, ~$2,220,704 all-time. Last sync Oct 4, 2026 ~04:09 Warsaw (02:09 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Pick one home-service trade in one country (AU cleaners, UK gardeners, PL HVAC) and own booking + invoicing + simple marketing site. Sell to owners, not marketers.

whyItPrints: Local-services OS. Field businesses hate juggling calendars, invoices, and marketing sites; once jobs and payments live in ConvertLabs, they renew. Mid-tier ACV × hundreds of logos = steady ~$28k MRR and $2.2M+ all-time — Calendesk/Khosmos cousin for US home services.
